topic: NASA Astronaut Chris Williams Completes Successful Space Mission
headline: NASA ASTRONAUT CHRIS WILLIAMS COMPLETES SUCCESSFUL SPACE MISSION, DODGES EVACUATION ALERT OVER AIR LEAKS
summary: NASA astronaut Chris Williams, along with Russian cosmonauts Sergey Kud-Sverchkov and Sergey Mikaev, successfully launched to the International Space Station on the Soyuz MS-28 spacecraft and docked about three hours later. The crew's mission was briefly put on alert for possible evacuation due to air leaks in the Russian section of the space station, but they were reported to be in good health. The launch site in Kazakhstan was damaged during the spacecraft launch. Chris Williams completed his space mission, although details of its duration and specific accomplishments are not provided.
